title: Casablanca
synopsis: Casablanca, 1941. You run a small nightclub. Of all the gin joints in all the world, she walks into yours. With her husband. With letters of transit in your safe.

nodes.text: Smoke, piano, refugees in the corners. You don't drink with customers.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Walk the room” back. Owner shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Distance.

nodes.text: He hands you the letters of transit. He is, by sunrise, dead.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Hide them.” The story records the instinct as “Smart” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.

nodes.text: He shrugs. He plays both sides. He is, mostly, a friend.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wise—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Trust him fully” back. Naive shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: German command. He has a list. Your name is, perhaps, on it.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Stay polite.” The story records the instinct as “Survive” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: He plays only what you say.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Friend.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Discipline.

nodes.text: She walks in. Sam sees her. He doesn't play it. She asks.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Pride—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Greet her” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.

nodes.text: Sam plays it. You walk out. She looks up.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Pride.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Truth.

nodes.text: Her husband. Czech resistance. Hunted.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Be civil” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Pride—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You alone, in the world, have them. Two exits to Lisbon.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.
There is no taking “Hint to Renault” back. Strategic shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: A train station, a letter, rain on the platform.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Bury it” back. Survive shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Late, she comes to your office. She tells you her side.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honor.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Pride—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Laszlo leads the band. The room rises. Strasser's face goes hard.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honor.
There is no taking “Don't intervene” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Late. A gun. Tears. She tells you she loves you.

choices.consequence: “Believe her” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Heart.
“Doubt her” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.

nodes.text: You decide which two get the letters.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Heart.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You set up the captain. You set the plan.

choices.consequence: “Brief him false” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Strategy.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Naive.

nodes.text: You tell Laszlo he must take Ilsa. You don't tell him you and she nearly stayed.

choices.consequence: “Be plain” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.
There is no taking “Be careful” back. Tone shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Fog. A plane. Strasser arriving.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Action—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Patience.

nodes.text: Ilsa, you say, the problems of three little people don't amount to a hill of beans.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Speak the speech.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Speak only the gist.” The story records the instinct as “Style” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: He arrives. He calls headquarters. You raise the pistol.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.

nodes.text: He says round up the usual suspects. He is, finally, choosing.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Welcome him.” The story records the instinct as “Friend” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.

nodes.text: You and Renault, in the fog, talk about a Free French garrison.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You and Renault join the resistance. The war ends, eventually. You return to Casablanca after, an older man. The cafe, somehow, is still there.
Years after the war, Ilsa, widowed, finds you in Paris. You sit at a cafe. The world has changed. You haven't, much.
You die during the war, in a small action that doesn't make the papers. Sam, eventually, plays the song again, somewhere, to no one in particular. He smiles.
